source_code.description: Portable BrainChop command line interface using tinygrad.

browser_application.note: Browser app is useful for manual/interactive segmentation but the CLI is preferred here for reproducible batch experiments.

local_runtime_notes: brainchop --list works after pip install brainchop==0.2.5.
The CLI calls niimath through PATH; activate the venv before running.
tinygrad CPU backend requires clang; gcc alone is insufficient because tinygrad passes --target=x86_64-none-unknown-elf.
A subcortical smoke run with brainchop==0.2.4 on 2024 T1 FFE 401 reached inference but did not finish within a 15 minute local CPU window.
brainchop==0.2.5 tissue_fast completed on 2024 T1 FFE 401, 2024 T1 FFE 601, and 2024 3DI within a 5 minute per-scan limit.
brainchop==0.2.5 mindgrab timed out at 5 minutes per scan on the same 2024 candidates in the current CPU wrapper.
brainchop==0.2.5 subcortical-mini timed out at 10 minutes on 2024 T1 FFE 401.
